Composition & Indication

Losartan 50mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Cozaar®) contains Losartan Potassium 50 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 50mg strength. The standard indication is the management of high blood pressure (hypertension), per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Losartan 50mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use.
